ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), OR( NOT(REGEX(IDR_AuthRep_Licence_Number__c, "^[0-9]{0,6}$")), NOT(REGEX(IDR_AuthRep_Representative_Number__c, "^[0-9]{0,6}$")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The following fields are limited to 6 digits only: Licence Number, Representative/Credit Identifier Number. They cannot contain letters, symbols or special characters.
